name: Skirmish at Echo Ridge
objectiveText: Kill 12 Kobold Laborers , then return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.   Kobold Laborer slain  ( 12 )

Cave on top of Northshire Abbey

Hi all 

On this quest you need to kill 12 [npc=80]. You can find them in Echo Ridge Mine north from Northshire Abbey. Quest is take it from [npc=197] and return to him, He is located inside Northshire Abbey.

See My Video if need it - https://youtu.be/vAf073B3Flg

Hope that help You :)
This quest rewards 250 Stormwind reputation as of patch 2.01

Continue Quest Text (from Marshal McBride):

"I know it's bloody work, <name>, but it's vital to the safety of Northshire. Are you ready to report?"

Complete Quest Text (from Marshal McBride):

"Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army. There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them. We have further tasks for you."
